## Purpose

Enable the AITER Triton FP8 paths on **RDNA3**, bringing it to parity with the gfx12/RDNA4 enablement. This also completes full GPU kernel support for **dsv4** models.
## Major Changes
* enable AITER unified attention if `VLLM_USE_AITER`=1. the priority is after `ROCM_ATTN` and before `TRITON_ATTN`.
* enable AITER GDN kernel.
* Widen most gates to all of RDNA which were only for RDNA4.

**Relationship to prior work:**

- **Continuation / mirror of #43615**. This PR
extends the exact same mechanism to gfx11/RDNA3 — both are RDNA, neither has a CK build, so only aiter's Triton kernels exist on either. Instead of duplicating the gate for a third arch, it switches the two RDNA gates to the canonical `on_rdna()` predicate (`gfx11 + gfx12`, minus CDNA gfx1250), so every downstream site (fp8 MoE oracles, blockscale linear, quant-fusion passes, pass-manager, GDN, sparse-MLA) lights up for gfx11 with no per-site edits.

- **Supplement to #47017**. That PR made DSV4
*run* on gfx11 but relied on the op-level **CPU/torch
fallback**, without broadly enabling AITER. The usage of "item()" from PyTorch fail cudagraph capture and can only be used with --enforce-eager". 
This PR removes that torch-fallback dependence for gfx11 by registering **all** aiter ops through the general path and
partially reverted the fragile _direct_register_custom_op_() for single kernel.

- **Supersedes #51555** . It adds a *separate* kernel that dequantizes fp8 → bf16 **in-kernel** before `tl.dot`, when the Triton compiler already implicitly does the same work during lowering, after minor fix https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/4764. Simply adapting the Aiter's kernel is cleaner.

## Test Plan

Hardware: 8× AMD Radeon Pro W7900 (gfx1100 / RDNA3), TP=8. Model: `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731`. `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`.

Server (cudagraph mode):
```bash
export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 TRITON_AMD_REAL_TRUE16=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
       VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB=256 PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

vllm serve /mnt/raid/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --served-model-name DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.93 \
  --dtype auto --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --trust-remote-code \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4 --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"greedy"}' \
  --enforce-eager \
  --max-model-len 4096 --max-num-seqs 2 --max-num-batched-tokens 1024
```
lm_eval command
```
M=DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
TOK=DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731

/opt/venv/bin/lm_eval --model local-chat-completions \
  --model_args "model=$M,base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions,num_concurrent=32,max_retries=3,timeout=600,tokenizer=$TOK,max_gen_toks=2048" \
  --apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 \
  --use_cache eval_dsv4_gsm8k/cache_full_rebased \
  --output_path eval_dsv4_gsm8k/full_rebased --log_samples
```

## Test Result
```
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.8840|±  |0.0088|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.6187|±  |0.0134|
(96/1319 empty due to the 2048-token gen budget → 0.953 on the 1223 answered.) dsv4 has a thinking module.
```
---

**Not a duplicate:** re-checked against open PRs (`gfx11 aiter`, `rdna3`) on
2026-08-19. No open PR folds gfx11 into the AITER RDNA gates. It mirrors merged #43615,
supplements merged #47017, and supersedes open #51555 for the gfx1100 case (see
Purpose).

# DeepSeek-V4 Flash gfx1151 validation update

I validated the temporary gfx1151 paged-MQA routing fix on the 2-node Strix Halo setup via Ray and VLLM.

## Hardware / Topology

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Nodes | `frame3`, `frame4` |
| GPU | AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics |
| GPU arch | `gfx1151` |
| Host memory | about 128 GiB unified memory per node |
| Distributed runtime | Ray + NCCL/RCCL-compatible transport over Ethernet |
| Tensor parallelism | TP=2 |
| Model | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` |

## Test Plan

Full GSM8K and 1M-Token Long-Context End-to-End Test stack:

| Component | Version / value |
|---|---|
| AITER source | `04907edc21c773d7e70e87b56f9ed741b3197497` |
| ROCm env | `ROCM_VERSION=10.1.0a20260816` |
| Triton | `3.7.x0 & 3.8.0 (smoke testing only)` |
| Target arch env | `PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=gfx1151`, `AITER_ROCM_ARCH=gfx1151`, `AMDGPU_TARGETS=gfx1151` |

GSM8K testing command:

```bash
reports/xavier-clean-gfx1151/lm_eval_venv/bin/lm-eval run \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args "model=/mnt/nas_share/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731,base_url=http://frame3:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=4,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=none,timeout=1800,max_gen_toks=512" \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 5 \
  --limit 20 \ (added with smoke testing)
  --output_path reports/xavier-clean-gfx1151/gsm8k_t38_stage1_limit20_20260825T231238Z/results \
  --log_samples
```


Server command:

```bash
vllm serve /mnt/nas_share/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --distributed-executor-backend ray \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8
```

1M request command:

```bash
curl http://frame3:8000/v1/completions -d '{"model":"/mnt/nas_share/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731","prompt":"<1,048,320 tokens>","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0}'
```

## Test Results

### GSM8K testing result

GSM8K end-to-end accuracy:

| flexible-extract exact_match | strict-match exact_match | Request progress | Runtime |
|---:|---:|---|---|
| 0.9499620924943138 ± 0.006005442354577739 | 0.9499620924943138 ± 0.006005442354577739 | 1319/1319 | ~5h 33m 48s |

### 1M VLLM serving result

| Field | Value |
|---|---:|
| HTTP status | `200` |
| Prompt tokens | `1048320` |
| Completion tokens | `256` |
| Total tokens | `1048576` |
| Wall time | `50344.2096991539` seconds, about `13h 59m 04s` |

### Smoking testing on Triton 3.8.0

|flexible-extract exact_match | strict-match exact_match | Request progress | Runtime |
|---:|---:|---|---|
|1.0 ± 0.0 | 1.0 ± 0.0 | 5/5 | ~2m 29s |

## Fix applied

Two gfx1151-scoped changes were applied:

The finalized branch applies two narrow gfx1151 compatibility changes. First, gfx1151 is routed away from the non-stage1 AITER paged-MQA decode kernel and through the existing stage1 path, because the non-stage1 path faults on gfx1151 under non-eager mode with multiple active decode rows. Other RDNA/CDNA targets keep the existing non-stage1 dispatch.

Second, the block-scaled FP8 Triton matmul keeps the explicit FP8-to-upcast workaround only on gfx1151 with Triton versions earlier than 3.8. This preserves the validated Triton 3.7 behavior while allowing Triton 3.8 or newer runtimes to use the direct FP8 `tl.dot` path.

Nice work bringing gfx11 in line with RDNA4. Switching to `on_rdna()` instead of adding another per-arch gate is the right call, and good to see DSv4 running on W7900s.

Two things I noticed while reading it against current main:

The native sparse indexer path from #47017 goes away for gfx11. `register_ops_once()` and `forward_hip()` both drop `on_gfx11()`, so DSv4 on gfx11 without `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` would now hit the "requires AITER" error. I get the reasoning, since that path uses `.item()` and only works in eager. If AITER becoming mandatory for DSv4 on gfx11 is intended, it would help to say so in the description, so someone who hits that error knows it's by design.

The scope is also a bit wider than DSv4. With `is_rdna_aiter_enabled()` true on gfx11, `GDN_AITER_TRITON_AVAILABLE` flips as well, so Qwen3.5/3.8-style hybrid models on gfx11 switch to the AITER GDN decode kernels. A quick run with one of those (even a small GSM8K) would make it much easier to trust that this doesn't move anything for existing gfx11 users.

Thanks for the heads-up on 28c420e! Happy to keep the AITER unified attention change in this PR, as long as we have some gfx11 data behind it. Since `ROCM_ATTN` sits first, the normal accuracy runs won't actually go through AITER unified attention, so could you add one run forcing it? Something like the Qwen3.5 GSM8K with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` and `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN`, plus the same with `TRITON_ATTN` for comparison (accuracy and tok/s). Together with the DSv4 GSM8K on gfx1100 and a line in the description about the new priority, I'm happy to approve the whole thing in one go.

Been spending to to fix a regression introduced in #57451: it moved the DSv4 decode inverse-RoPE into the sparse decode-reduce kernel, but that fused rotation only exists in the gfx942/gfx950 split-K reduce kernel.

On RDNA, decode falls to the fallback kernel, which does not rotate — yet
`rocm_sparse_attn_decode` still returns every decode row as rotated, so the standalone
`rocm_inverse_rope_rows_ pass` skips them. Decode output is therefore never inverse-RoPE'd
→ garbage generation (prefill/TTFT stays coherent). 

Fix: exclude RDNA from `fuse_decode_inv_rope` exactly as `gfx1250` already is, so decode rows fall to the standalone
pass (rotated=0 → rotate every row).

# DeepSeek-V4 Flash gfx1151 validation update

I validated the temporary gfx1151 paged-MQA routing fix on the 2-node Strix Halo setup via Ray and VLLM.

## Hardware / Topology

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Nodes | `frame3`, `frame4` |
| GPU | AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics |
| GPU arch | `gfx1151` |
| Host memory | about 128 GiB unified memory per node |
| Distributed runtime | Ray + NCCL/RCCL-compatible transport over Ethernet |
| Tensor parallelism | TP=2 |
| Model | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731` |

## Test Plan

Full GSM8K and 1M-Token Long-Context End-to-End Test stack:

| Component | Version / value |
|---|---|
| AITER source | `04907edc21c773d7e70e87b56f9ed741b3197497` |
| ROCm env | `ROCM_VERSION=10.1.0a20260816` |
| Triton | `3.7.x0 & 3.8.0 (smoke testing only)` |
| Target arch env | `PYTORCH_ROCM_ARCH=gfx1151`, `AITER_ROCM_ARCH=gfx1151`, `AMDGPU_TARGETS=gfx1151` |

GSM8K testing command:

```bash
reports/xavier-clean-gfx1151/lm_eval_venv/bin/lm-eval run \
  --model local-completions \
  --model_args "model=/mnt/nas_share/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731,base_url=http://frame3:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=4,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=none,timeout=1800,max_gen_toks=512" \
  --tasks gsm8k \
  --num_fewshot 5 \
  --limit 20 \ (added with smoke testing)
  --output_path reports/xavier-clean-gfx1151/gsm8k_t38_stage1_limit20_20260825T231238Z/results \
  --log_samples
```


Server command:

```bash
vllm serve /mnt/nas_share/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --distributed-executor-backend ray \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8
```

1M request command:

```bash
curl http://frame3:8000/v1/completions -d '{"model":"/mnt/nas_share/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731","prompt":"<1,048,320 tokens>","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0}'
```

## Test Results

### GSM8K testing result

GSM8K end-to-end accuracy:

| flexible-extract exact_match | strict-match exact_match | Request progress | Runtime |
|---:|---:|---|---|
| 0.9499620924943138 ± 0.006005442354577739 | 0.9499620924943138 ± 0.006005442354577739 | 1319/1319 | ~5h 33m 48s |

### 1M VLLM serving result

| Field | Value |
|---|---:|
| HTTP status | `200` |
| Prompt tokens | `1048320` |
| Completion tokens | `256` |
| Total tokens | `1048576` |
| Wall time | `50344.2096991539` seconds, about `13h 59m 04s` |

### Smoking testing on Triton 3.8.0

|flexible-extract exact_match | strict-match exact_match | Request progress | Runtime |
|---:|---:|---|---|
|1.0 ± 0.0 | 1.0 ± 0.0 | 5/5 | ~2m 29s |

## Fix applied

Two gfx1151-scoped changes were applied:

The finalized branch applies two narrow gfx1151 compatibility changes. First, gfx1151 is routed away from the non-stage1 AITER paged-MQA decode kernel and through the existing stage1 path, because the non-stage1 path faults on gfx1151 under non-eager mode with multiple active decode rows. Other RDNA/CDNA targets keep the existing non-stage1 dispatch.

Second, the block-scaled FP8 Triton matmul keeps the explicit FP8-to-upcast workaround only on gfx1151 with Triton versions earlier than 3.8. This preserves the validated Triton 3.7 behavior while allowing Triton 3.8 or newer runtimes to use the direct FP8 `tl.dot` path.

Nice work bringing gfx11 in line with RDNA4. Switching to `on_rdna()` instead of adding another per-arch gate is the right call, and good to see DSv4 running on W7900s.

Two things I noticed while reading it against current main:

The native sparse indexer path from #47017 goes away for gfx11. `register_ops_once()` and `forward_hip()` both drop `on_gfx11()`, so DSv4 on gfx11 without `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` would now hit the "requires AITER" error. I get the reasoning, since that path uses `.item()` and only works in eager. If AITER becoming mandatory for DSv4 on gfx11 is intended, it would help to say so in the description, so someone who hits that error knows it's by design.

The scope is also a bit wider than DSv4. With `is_rdna_aiter_enabled()` true on gfx11, `GDN_AITER_TRITON_AVAILABLE` flips as well, so Qwen3.5/3.8-style hybrid models on gfx11 switch to the AITER GDN decode kernels. A quick run with one of those (even a small GSM8K) would make it much easier to trust that this doesn't move anything for existing gfx11 users.

Thanks for the heads-up on 28c420e! Happy to keep the AITER unified attention change in this PR, as long as we have some gfx11 data behind it. Since `ROCM_ATTN` sits first, the normal accuracy runs won't actually go through AITER unified attention, so could you add one run forcing it? Something like the Qwen3.5 GSM8K with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` and `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN`, plus the same with `TRITON_ATTN` for comparison (accuracy and tok/s). Together with the DSv4 GSM8K on gfx1100 and a line in the description about the new priority, I'm happy to approve the whole thing in one go.

Been spending to to fix a regression introduced in #57451: it moved the DSv4 decode inverse-RoPE into the sparse decode-reduce kernel, but that fused rotation only exists in the gfx942/gfx950 split-K reduce kernel.

On RDNA, decode falls to the fallback kernel, which does not rotate — yet
`rocm_sparse_attn_decode` still returns every decode row as rotated, so the standalone
`rocm_inverse_rope_rows_ pass` skips them. Decode output is therefore never inverse-RoPE'd
→ garbage generation (prefill/TTFT stays coherent). 

Fix: exclude RDNA from `fuse_decode_inv_rope` exactly as `gfx1250` already is, so decode rows fall to the standalone
pass (rotated=0 → rotate every row). 

dsv4 Model eval has been updated to main PR body. It would be nice we can merge this PR soon as it should fix the same issue on gfx12. Although no one reports it yet, the output emits GARBAGE before this PR.

## Qwen3.5-4B model evaluation on single gfx1100

This model contains both GDN and regular MHA attention, so serving it satisfies both purposes.


Backend A — ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN
```
Server:
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 TRITON_AMD_REAL_TRUE16=1 \
/opt/venv/bin/vllm serve /mnt/nas_share/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B \
  --served-model-name Qwen3.5-4B --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 --trust-remote-code \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}' \
  --max-model-len 8192 --max-num-seqs 32

lm_eval:
/opt/venv/bin/lm_eval --model local-chat-completions \
  --model_args "model=Qwen3.5-4B,base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions,num_concurrent=32,max_retries=3,timeout=600,tokenizer=/mnt/nas_share/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B,max_gen_toks=1024" \
  --apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 \
  --use_cache /tmp/lmcache_qwen35_unified \
  --output_path eval_qwen35_4b/unified --log_samples


Raw GSM8K output (n=1319):
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9098|±  |0.0079|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9098|±  |0.0079|
```
Backend B — TRITON_ATTN
```
Server: same as above but swap one flag:
  --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN \

lm_eval: 
/opt/venv/bin/lm_eval --model local-chat-completions \
  --model_args "model=Qwen3.5-4B,base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions,num_concurrent=32,max_retries=3,timeout=600,tokenizer=/mnt/nas_share/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B,max_gen_toks=1024" \
  --apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 \
  --use_cache /tmp/lmcache_qwen35_triton \
  --output_path eval_qwen35_4b/triton --log_samples

Raw GSM8K output (n=1319):
